title: HireDraft walkthrough · Fictional sample data, live AI generation
1. Add the opportunity — paste a job description
2. Review the role's requirements before continuing
3. Upload your resume — PDF or DOCX
4. Review and confirm the experience extracted from your resume
5. Choose a provider and generate your application email
6. Review your subject and body — you can edit both
7. Copy, export, open in Gmail, or save this version
Your application, ready for your final review. Nothing sends automatically.
